note: Equatorial Guinea: nationals of Barbados and the other CEMAC states enter without a visa, Turks and Emiratis for 90 days, Tunisians for 30; everyone else applies for an e-Visa (since 1 July 2023; USD 75; arriving at Malabo). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Equatorial Guinea
sources.said: All visitors to Equatorial Guinea must obtain an e-visa prior to arrival, unless they come from one of the visa exempt countries mentioned below. ... Citizens of the following countries can visit Equatorial Guinea without a visa: Barbados Tunisia (30 days) Turkey (90 days) United Arab Emirates (90 days) CEMAC countries with national identity card or biometric passport: Cameroon Central African Republic Chad Republic of the Congo Gabon ... People of all nationalities can apply, and the processing fee is 75 USD .
